dependencies.requirement: Choose and provision an HTTPS application host; this theme repository contains no authenticated backend runtime.
Create or identify a Shopify app, configure its app proxy, install it on Rhino Lapidary, and grant write_draft_orders, read_products, and write_app_proxy.
Store the app shared secret and offline Admin access token in the selected host's server-side secret manager.
Provision a durable database with an atomic unique idempotency claim and a durable per-shop and per-client rate limiter.
Configure and obtain the Shopify protected customer data access needed for quotation email, phone, and shipping address fields.

Complete preview end-to-end acceptance with a real draft, timeout reconciliation, staff Admin inspection, and proof that no invoice, payment, shipping line, reservation, completion, or pickup draft occurred.
